name: AFNI NMT v2 and CHARM
purpose: Provide a NIMH Macaque Template (NMT) with the accompanying Cortical Hierarchy Atlas of the Rhesus Macaque (CHARM), which parcellates the macaque cortex at six spatial scales in NMT v2 coordinates.

inputs.statement: The NMT v2 template and its accompanying matching CHARM dataset, obtained from the NMT download.
inputs.quote:
The CHARM is distributed with the NMT v2. The NMT v2 has several forms
and variants (based on symmetry/asymmetry, FOV and voxel size), and
for each of these there is an accompanying CHARM.

inputs.statement: The NMT download also includes a CSV table file of the ROI labels, hierarchically organized.
inputs.quote:
the NMT download also includes a CSV table file of the ROI
labels, hierarchically organized

conditions.statement: The CHARM is defined in the coordinates/space of the NMT v2 template.
conditions.quote:
This atlas is defined in the coordinates/space of the NMT v2
template

conditions.statement: For each form/variant of the NMT (symmetry/asymmetry, FOV, voxel size), there is a matching CHARM dataset.
conditions.quote:
The NMT v2 has several forms
and variants (based on symmetry/asymmetry, FOV and voxel size), and
for each of these there is an accompanying CHARM.

conditions.statement: The -sym option is valid for the NMT v2 only; in other cases it is ignored.
conditions.quote:
Option is valid for the NMT v2 only--in
other cases it is ignored.

steps.statement: Run @Install_NMT to install the NMT with the accompanying CHARM.
steps.quote:
Installs the NIMH Macaque Template (NMT) with the accompanying
Cortical Hierarchy Atlas of the Rhesus Macaque (CHARM).

steps.statement: Choose the template version and variant via the -nmt_ver and -sym options.
steps.quote:
Note there are multiple versions and variants of the template to
choose from

steps.statement: After the archive is downloaded and unpacked as the directory "NMT_*", see its README.txt for details.
steps.quote:
After the archive is downloaded and unpacked (as the directory
"NMT_*", depending on your selected version+variant), see its
README.txt for details.

steps.statement: Select the desired CHARM level from the six sub-volumes using AFNI sub-brick selectors.
steps.quote:
CHARM Level 1 is volume "[0]" and Level 6 is volume
"[5]"

exceptions.statement: The -overwrite option allows the script to remove a pre-existing NMT directory.
exceptions.quote: -overwrite :allows the script to remove a pre-existing NMT directory

exceptions.statement: AFNI uses zero-base counting, so CHARM Level 1 is volume "[0]" and Level 6 is volume "[5]".
exceptions.quote:
CHARM Level 1 is volume "[0]" and Level 6 is volume
"[5]", because AFNI (like Python and C) use zero-base counting.

outputs.statement: An unpacked NMT_* directory containing the NMT and matching CHARM data.
outputs.quote:
After the archive is downloaded and unpacked (as the directory
"NMT_*"

outputs.statement: The CHARM as a single data set with six sub-volumes (six parcellation levels).
outputs.quote:
The CHARM is distributed as a single data set with six
sub-volumes.

outputs.statement: A CSV table file of the hierarchically organized ROI labels.
outputs.quote:
a CSV table file of the ROI
labels, hierarchically organized

parameters.statement: -install_dir DD sets the install location for the NMT (default = the PWD).
parameters.quote:
-install_dir DD :the install location for the NMT
(default = the PWD)

parameters.statement: -nmt_ver VV selects the NMT version (default = 2.1; valid = 2.1, 2.0, 1.3, 1.2).
parameters.quote:
-nmt_ver VV :the version of the NMT you wish to install
(default = 2.1; valid = 2.1, 2.0, 1.3, 1.2)

parameters.statement: -sym SS selects the NMT v2 variant as "sym" or "asym" (default = "sym").
parameters.quote:
Specify the desired variant SS as either "sym" or
"asym". Option is valid for the NMT v2 only--in
other cases it is ignored. (default = "sym")

parameters.statement: The default template is the symmetric NMT v2.1.
parameters.quote:
with
the default being the symmetric NMT v2.1
